title: D2VI: Detect, Then What? Valid Social Measurement from AI-Contaminated Response Data (software, frozen protocol and result tables)
description: Python package d2vi, frozen experimental protocol, corpus configurations, tests, Kaggle/Colab notebooks and the compact result tables from which every held-out number of the paper is reproduced (results/compact/S5). Companion to the article submitted to Neurocomputing (NEUCOM-D-26-20926).
